_how: One entry per moment. Change, add or remove lines in each list; keep the keys. Swearing: write #@$%! and it is bleeped. Keep lines short (under about 70 characters) so the bubble stays small.

noBeer.when: He has just sat down, reaches into his cooler and finds no beer
lines: Six beers short of a personality, kid.
Empty cooler. Just like your calendar.
Cold air. Breakfast of champions, boss.
You call this stocking? That's a draft.
Beer's a liquid, kid. Not a rumor.
Oh, #@$%! Somebody forgot the point.

askMoney.when: He stands up and asks you for money (his bubble shows the Give him $5 button)
lines: Five bucks, kid. Beer ain't free. Neither am I.
Pay up, boss. It's a tax on my charm.
Sponsor a thirsty legend, kid.
My throat filed a complaint. Fund it.
Five dollars. Dirt cheap for my company.
Come on. My dignity is already spent.

stillWaiting.when: You still have not paid: he nags every 25 seconds or so and shakes your screen
lines: Still dry, kid. My tongue is pressing charges.
Boss, your wallet is on airplane mode.
Tick tock. The ice is dead, kid.
Any slower and I'll die of scenery.
Your generosity took a wrong turn, kid.
Fine, kid. You're almost useful now.
Thanks. Now I have a reason to sit.
Generous. Don't make it a habit, boss.
Look at you. Funding a legend.
Good kid. Guard my chair. Seriously.

backWithBeer.when: Back from the shop with a can, sitting down again
lines: Crisis over, kid. Civilization resumes.
Behold, boss. Your money, now drinkable.
Shopkeeper says you're a cheapskate. Agreed.
The cooler has purpose again. So do you.
Cheers, genius. Now shut up and sit.

scold.when: Every few minutes: scolds you for nothing
lines: You blink like a man with no plan.
Stop looking busy. You're fooling nobody.
Your ambition is in my light, kid.
Boss, that idea was a mistake. I heard it.
Careful. You're wearing out the air.
You sit down like you actually earned it.
Must you breathe like you're in charge?
Look at you, wasting prime napping hours.
Don't make my laziness look deliberate.
Nobody voted for you being awake, kid.
Keep that twitchy cursor off my peace.
Somehow your silence is still smug.
Great. Annoyed me without moving.
You need supervision. From someone better.
Enough, slacker. You're relaxing wrong.
My beard is a retired weather report.
Clouds look unemployed. Respect.
Fish never pay rent. Shady little tenants.
A sandwich is just lunch in a coat.
Naps should count as experience.
Gravity overachieves. Show-off.
Soup is a drink with an ego.
Every pocket deserves an emergency biscuit.
Chairs are trousers for the lazy.
Time flies. Mine just sits.
Rubber ducks know things.
Silence sounds better with a beer.
Tuesday is a damp sock.
Boots are buckets with ambition.
Somewhere a worm is late for work.
Dreams need fewer stairs.
Nobody audits clouds. Lucky bastards.
Retirement is competitive sitting.
Lakes are puddles that got cocky.
Breakfast needs a pillow, honestly.

attention.when: You have not touched him for a long time: he wants attention
lines: Oi. My silence needs an audience.
Kid, come watch me do nothing.
I require pointless supervision, boss.
I'm being ignored. Professionally.
Hello? Your best problem is down here.
Look alive. I can't do everything alone.
Over here, kid. Bring snacks.
Boss, I forgot why. Stay anyway.

noFish.when: Nothing has bitten for a long time: frustrated (sometimes flops on his back)
lines: You scared them with competence, kid.
Even the worms look embarrassed.
Apologize to the water, boss.
The fish muted you, kid.
Tell your fish friends I'm losing patience.
Brilliant. You bored the bait.
At this rate we'll catch old age.
Another magnificent bucket of nothing.
Your clicking offended the whole lake.
Oh, #@$%! Even fish dodge you.

takeBreak.when: You have been at your Mac too long: tells you to take a break
lines: Stand up. The chair won't marry you.
Drink water, boss. You're a dried fish.
Look away, genius. Pixels survive.
Rest your eyes. I'll watch the nothing.
Stretch. You're becoming a question mark.
Blink, kid. You're staring harder than my fish.
Walk it off. Bring back less stress.
Nap. You make mine look lazy.

stone.when: Right after he throws a stone and cracks your screen
lines: You ignored me. The pebble booked a meeting.
Special delivery. One very firm reminder.
Boss, that's my rock of concern.
My rock has better timing than you.
Fine. I'll knock on your screen.
That's the official pebble of disapproval.

caughtFish.when: You landed a fish (he dances to banjo)
lines: Applaud now. Briefly. Then louder.
Behold, kid. A fish with excellent taste.
Greatness stinks. Hold the bucket, boss.
The fish recognized my authority.
Watch, kid. This belly can dance.
Now you can brag about knowing me.
Stand back. Victory needs elbow room.
Remember this. I was briefly useful.
Applause. My lunch deserves an entrance.
Tell everyone, kid. Especially the fish.

caughtJunk.when: You landed junk (a boot, a can)
lines: Seafood? I want a refund.
Behold. Dinner for absolutely nobody.
Lovely. Your rubbish arrived, boss.
Congrats. We caught an unpaid chore.
Dinner's canceled. Eat disappointment.
What wine pairs with rubbish, boss?
Your junk learned to swim. Great.
Oh, #@$%! You're cleaning this.

gotAway.when: The fish got away (you let go too early)
lines: You gave it slack and a goodbye party.
Loose line. Very charitable, kid.
Congrats, boss. You freed my dinner.
Next time, send it home with beer.
You work for the fish now, apparently.
There goes lunch. Proud of yourself?

snapped.when: The line snapped (you held on too long, needle in the red)
lines: You reeled like the lake owed you money.
Gently! That line had retirement plans.
Congrats. You caught two short strings.
We wanted fish, not demolition, kid.

ignoredBite.when: A fish bit and you did nothing
lines: You missed dinner. It knocked and everything.
Busy, boss? The fish canceled on us.
Even my nap caught that bite, kid.
The bait outworked you. Congrats.
Explain yourself to lunch next time.

pulledIn.when: A big fish pulled him into the water: said when he climbs back out
lines: You fish. I'll wring out my dignity.
Thanks. My boots are aquariums now.
Your teamwork soaked my trousers, boss.
Brilliant. Even my beard needs a towel.
Next time, you're the bait.
Oh, #@$%! You owe me dry socks.

poke.when: You click or press on him while he sits
lines: You poked it. Now you fund it.
Hands off. This belly is private property.
I'm a fisherman, not a doorbell.
Careful. That beard has seniority.
Poking costs extra. Pay in beer.
Unless you're a sandwich, stop tapping.
Go poke your unfinished work, kid.
That finger could fetch me a beer.
Keep clicking. I'm billing overtime.
Touch my hat again. It charges rent.

wake.when: You click him while he is asleep and snoring: he wakes up and scolds you
lines: You interrupted important nothing.
Quiet. I was winning an argument asleep.
My dream had better service, boss.
Unless that's beer, put the nap back.

burp.when: After a sip of beer he sometimes burps
lines: You heard nothing. The chair is haunted.
Relax. That was dinner applauding.
Excuse you, boss. Someone had to say it.
Blame the bubbles. I was outnumbered.

fart.when: He farts in his chair and blames you
lines: Excuse you. The fish have noses.
Boss, your manners have sprung a leak.
That came from your side of the dock.
Easy. You're peeling the paint.
Your wind. My chair is the witness.
Lovely. You've pickled the lake.
Keep it up. The worms are packing.
Oh, #@$%! Warn the fish next time.
